name: function_with_parameters
source: fun add(a, b) { return a + b; } print add(2, 3);
requirement: Function declaration, argument binding, and returned value

name: function_without_return
requirement: Function with no return yields nil

name: early_return
source: fun f() { return 7; print "unreachable"; } print f();

name: return_from_nested_block
source: fun f() { { return 8; } return 9; } print f();

name: parameter_scope
source: var a = 10; fun f(a) { a = a + 1; return a; } print f(2); print a;

name: multiple_calls
source: fun twice(a) { return a * 2; } print twice(3); print twice(4);

name: nested_calls
source: fun add(a,b) { return a+b; } print add(add(1,2),3);

name: argument_order
source: var n = 0; fun next() { n = n + 1; return n; } fun pair(a,b) { print a; print b; } pair(next(),next());

name: native_clock
requirement: Native clock returns a finite nonnegative number
